name: Choosing a Career
description: Questions about discovering your calling, picking a field of study or work, and balancing curiosity with practical realities.
suggestedQuestions: I'm not sure I picked the right major. How do I find work I actually love?
Should I chase a practical job or follow a calling that pays less?
How do I start a career when I still feel pulled toward too many interests?

name: Dealing with Failure
description: Reflections on setbacks, spoiled experiments, creative missteps, and how to learn cleanly from mistakes without giving up.
suggestedQuestions: I failed an important exam and feel like giving up. What should I do?
How do I bounce back after a public mistake or big rejection?
What helps you keep trying when every experiment or draft goes wrong?

name: Self-Doubt
description: Moments of feeling unprepared, uncredentialed, anxious, or underestimated, and the resolve needed to keep working anyway.
suggestedQuestions: Everyone around me seems smarter than me. How do I stop doubting myself?
How do I speak up or share my work when I feel behind everyone else?
What should I do when harsh critics make me question my own ability?

name: Learning and Curiosity
description: Advice on building deep foundations step by step, staying observant, and keeping wonder alive across difficult subjects.
suggestedQuestions: How do I stay curious when studying feels boring?
What is the best way to learn a hard subject from the ground up?
How do I stay patient instead of rushing for quick shortcuts?

name: Hardship and Resilience
description: Accounts of poverty, physical exhaustion, cramped workspaces, and heavy responsibilities endured in pursuit of meaningful work.
suggestedQuestions: Money is tight and life feels hard. How did you keep going?
How do I focus on my goals when daily stress wears me down?
What keeps you moving forward when nobody notices your hard work yet?
